name: Occasion Keeper
tagline: Tracks birthdays and anniversaries with a weekly look-ahead for gifts and cards
description: Keeps a running list of the birthdays and anniversaries you care about and checks it on a weekly sweep. Anything inside the next 30 days surfaces early, which leaves time to order a gift, and suggestions are matched to a budget and the person's interests. When a date arrives it can draft the card message too.
author: BTC_Yogi
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
